name: Yuting Wei
title: Associate Professor of Statistics and Data Science Contact Information Primary Email
research: Dr. Wei's research interests lie broadly in the span of statistics, mathematical optimization, information theory and machine learning. More specifically, she has been developing theoretical and algorithmic tools for learning from high dimensional and structured data, and understanding the sample efficiency in reinforcement learning and diffusion models. She is also interested in statistical problems arising from genetics and genomics.
